clue.text: Part of watch is used

definitions.meaning: the thin pointer on a dial that sweeps round once a minute
used goods are previously owned, not new

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a component of a watch has been used.
explanation.definitionFit: The fastest pointer on a clock face is named for the smallest unit it counts, and goods already owned by someone else are described with the same compound.

clue.text: See 22

definitions.meaning: to see something is to notice or catch sight of it
points to the answer at 22 down, a small skin blemish

explanation.walkthrough: 'See 22' looks like an ordinary cross-reference sending you to another clue, but it is itself a double definition: one verb meaning notice and one noun meaning a blemish.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch sight of something is to pick it out, and a pimple is a small blemish on the skin; one short word covers both.

clue.text: Crack cleric in charge in church

indicators.note: the second in puts the cleric and the charge abbreviation inside the church letters

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
REV is short for Reverend, a cleric

explanation.surface: A clergyman put in charge of a church cracks down.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow opening or fissure in rock or a wall is a crack.

clue.text: Emphatically no love before action

indicators.note: before puts the word for love ahead of the word for action

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, so nothing
doing is action, activity

explanation.surface: Someone says firmly that romance must come before anything physical.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an idiomatic flat refusal, a forceful way of saying not a chance.

clue.text: Taking no notice when they say he didn't have as much

indicators.note: they say signals that the phrase is to be heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: he did not have as much means he had less, contracted to he'd less

explanation.surface: Someone is oblivious when people point out that he had a smaller share.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken quickly, he'd less sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone careless pays no attention to warnings, which is the sense of failing to mind.

clue.text: Nut — an ingredient of chow mein

definitions.meaning: nut is slang for the head, and so is this word
chow mein is a Chinese dish of fried strands of pasta

explanation.surface: A list of what goes into a Chinese takeaway dish includes a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally the word means the head, like nut, and it is also the strand of pasta fried in chow mein.

clue.text: After retirement, go round the bend

indicators.note: retirement is a going back, so the word for go is read from its end

parts.note: a stab is a go, an attempt

explanation.surface: Once retired, someone goes mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are British informal terms for crazy, as in having bats in the belfry.

clue.text: In love, take the trouble to call

parts.note: ado is fuss or trouble, as in much ado
to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: A smitten person makes the effort to phone.
explanation.definitionFit: Being besotted with someone means worshipping them, which is the participle's sense.

clue.text: Mineral found in lake

definitions.meaning: a green rock-forming mineral with a snake-like mottled look
the long lake in Hyde Park, London, bears this name

explanation.surface: A geologist finds a mineral in a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The mineral is named for its snake-skin pattern, and the curving lake in Hyde Park, London, is called the same.

clue.text: Where Kitchener's men went to excess

definitions.meaning: Kitchener raised the British volunteer armies of the First World War, whose soldiers climbed out of the trenches to attack

explanation.surface: A remark that Kitchener's soldiers went too far.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops leaving the trench parapet to charge did this, and the idiom now means exaggerated or excessive.

clue.text: It's time I left seductive woman

indicators.note: left says the letter for I has gone from the word for the woman

parts.note: a houri is a beautiful nymph of the Islamic paradise, hence any seductive woman

explanation.surface: A man decides it is time to leave a temptress.
explanation.definitionFit: Sixty minutes is a unit of time.

clue.text: Engaging, accident-prone boy makes a bloomer

parts.note: sweet means charming or engaging
William Brown of Richmal Crompton's Just William stories is a British schoolboy always in scrapes

explanation.surface: A charming but clumsy lad makes a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder, which suits the accident-prone boy; here it means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: This garden plant is a biennial grown for its clusters of flowers, so it blooms.

clue.text: Talked of girl's wear

indicators.note: talked of signals that the girl's name is heard rather than seen

parts.note: Minnie is a girl's name

explanation.surface: People discuss what a girl wears.
explanation.definitionFit: A short skirt is an item of clothing, and wear here means garments.

clue.text: They will get concerned about one innocent

indicators.note: about means the stirred letters go round the letter for one
to get concerned is to be agitated, so the letters of the two words are stirred up

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: People will worry over somebody blameless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Concerned about' reads as worried over, but 'get concerned' is the anagram signal (giving LILYWHTE) and 'about' is a container round the I.
explanation.definitionFit: Pure white as a lily, figuratively blameless and without stain.

clue.text: He'd be after changing the mattress

indicators.note: changing signals the letters of the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man means to be swapping the bed for a new one.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft bed or mattress stuffed with plumage.

clue.text: Pep up American soldiers (and English) following Frenchman about

indicators.note: following places the soldiers and English after the Frenchman
about turns the French name back to front

parts.note: Rene is a typical French man's name
GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: GIs and an Englishman liven up after trailing a Frenchman.
explanation.definitionFit: To give energy to, to invigorate or enliven.

clue.text: Bluff Henry VIII

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
VIII is eight in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Bluff King Hal, Henry the Eighth, the hearty Tudor monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: Henry VIII was popularly called Bluff King Hal, so 'Bluff' looks like a description of him; here it is a cliff.
explanation.definitionFit: A bluff is a steep headland or cliff, a high place or elevation.

clue.text: The old suffer under thin clothing

indicators.note: under in a down clue puts the word for suffer beneath the word for thin

parts.note: gaunt means thin and haggard
suffer in its old sense means allow, as in suffer the little children, so let

explanation.surface: In the past people endured hardship wearing flimsy garments.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy protective glove is an item worn on the hand, so it counts as clothing.

clue.text: In prime time, only half turn over to Proms' opening

indicators.note: only half takes the first two of the word's four letters

parts.note: PTO, please turn over, printed at the foot of a page

indicators.note: opening takes the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: At a concert, mid-season, someone turns the page at the start of the Proms.
explanation.walkthrough: The Proms are the BBC's summer season of classical concerts in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe something excellent, of the best quality.

clue.text: Nationalist group participates in Wales… strike

indicators.note: participates in puts the group inside the word for strike

parts.note: to pat is to strike lightly
a trio is a group of three

explanation.surface: A nationalist faction joins a walkout.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone devoted to their country, a patriot, is a nationalist in spirit.

clue.text: Female striker gets rid of son to servant

indicators.note: gets rid of removes the letter for son from the female batter

parts.note: a batswoman strikes the ball in cricket

explanation.surface: A woman batter drops her son off with a servant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Female striker' looks like the definition; it is the wordplay, and the answer is the servant.
explanation.definitionFit: A female officer's personal attendant in the British forces, the counterpart of a batman.

clue.text: Red car carrying Brownies overturned

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue sends the whole assembly upward, read from its end
carrying puts the Brownies inside the car

parts.note: a tram is a car on rails
a Six is a patrol of Brownies, the junior Girl Guides in Britain

explanation.surface: A red-painted car full of little girl guides tips over.
explanation.definitionFit: Red is a byword for a communist, a follower of Marx.

clue.text: 26 police enter tall building

indicators.note: enter puts the police inside the tall building

parts.note: a pile is a large, imposing building
MP is Military Police

explanation.surface: Officers go into a tower block.
explanation.walkthrough: 26 points to the answer at 26 across, a boil, which here works as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A boil and a pimple are both inflamed swellings on the skin.

clue.text: No. sixteen has built an extra room or two

indicators.note: built signals the letters of No. sixteen are assembled into a new shape

parts.note: No. is taken as its two letters N and O

explanation.surface: House number sixteen has had an addition put on.
explanation.definitionFit: An addition built onto a house gives it one or more further rooms.

clue.text: In general, I rarely see money

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the words general, I rarely

explanation.surface: Someone complains they hardly ever have cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The former currency of Italy and Turkey, so a kind of money.

clue.text: One employing a devious ruse

indicators.note: devious means winding or crooked, so the letters are twisted

explanation.surface: Someone resorts to a crafty trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who employs something is a person who makes use of it.

clue.text: Quickly turn into vapour black, viscous liquid

parts.note: B is short for black, as on pencils
oil is a thick, viscous liquid

explanation.surface: Thick black oil rapidly vaporises.
explanation.definitionFit: Heating a liquid until it bubbles turns it fast into steam.

clue.text: Upset by family interrupting one's game

parts.note: to spill is to upset or knock over

indicators.note: interrupting puts the family between the letters for one's

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S
kin means family

explanation.surface: A relative barges in and ruins someone's game.
explanation.definitionFit: The game of picking straws from a heap without disturbing the rest is called this.

clue.text: Day and time engagement starts

indicators.note: starts takes the first letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: An appointment begins with a fixed day and hour.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed day, or an arranged meeting at a set time, both go by this name.

clue.text: Devised new tape measure — it's five feet long

indicators.note: devised means worked out afresh, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a meter is a device that measures, like a gas meter

explanation.surface: Someone invents a new tape measure exactly five feet in length.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Devised' turns N and TAPE into PENTA. Feet here are metrical feet, not lengths: a line of verse with five of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A line of verse made of five metrical units is so called, as in iambic verse.
